summary: North kerb beside a cleared lot, but homes about 20 m across a residential road.
reasons: Cleared lot and bush on kerb side

drivers.seclusion: North side is a demolished lot and bush with no home within about 40 m; homes opposite are 20 m (at 25 m and 79 m along) and 29 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane with a couple of cars parked; room for a van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through residential road, steady local traffic.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along this kerb, but it is a residential street with no clear overnight convention.

flags: Steep: about 5% over the best section, 8% max
Mapped office 11 m away appears demolished in recent Esri imagery
Homes 15 to 18 m away at the east start of the stretch
sun_shade: Mixed: tree shade over the kerb from the north side, open to morning and afternoon sun elsewhere.
rubbish: Some rubble from demolition on the lot behind, not dumped rubbish.

best_section.where: North kerb of Meiers Road beside the cleared lot and bush, before the western bend
